title: Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines): Period for Which Loss of Use Is Counted
content:
**Displacement period.** The displacement period is cut as follows: where a sale closing date falls on or after the date of loss and before the date of the latest adjuster report, the loss of use counted is multiplied by the days from the date of loss to the sale closing date over the days from the date of loss to the report date; where there is no such sale and the displacement months exceed the tier's maximum months, it is multiplied by those maximum months over the displacement months; otherwise the figure stands as reported.

The displacement months are the whole months from the date of loss to the date of the latest adjuster report, counted as at least one. The sale closing date is the cancellation effective date of the Tidemark HomeFlood policy (HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies) whose policy number is the underlying policy number on the excess policy record, where that policy was cancelled because the home was sold. The claim is the claim of the policy that carries the latest adjuster report, and every claim figure is read from that claim's own entries. Where two entries on a file share the date they are read by, or two policy records answer the same description, the one entered first is read.

Every share or period cut multiplies the loss of use counted; every amount deducted is then subtracted, never taking the figure below nothing; every allowance is then added; the loss-of-use limit then caps the result; payments already issued on the claim are subtracted after the cap; and every interest charge is added last.

| Tier | Excess Flood 250K | Excess Flood 500K | Excess Flood 1M | Excess Flood 2M | Excess Flood 3M | Excess Flood 5M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Maximum months | 12 | 12 | 12 | 18 | 24 | 24 |

| Situation | Multiplier on the loss of use counted |
|---|---|
| sale closing on or after the date of loss and before the latest report | days from loss to closing over days from loss to report |
| no such sale; displacement months above the tier's maximum months | maximum months over displacement months |
| otherwise | none; the figure stands |

**Illustrations (hypothetical).** Latest report 300 days after the loss, sale closing 120 days after it: multiplier 120 over 300, that is 0.4. On a 12-month tier with no such sale and 15 displacement months: 12 over 15, that is 0.8; with exactly 12 displacement months the figure stands.
